readBy: the builder of Round 1218, desktop Claude lane
method: Each page was opened on the read day through a page reader that answers with lines quoted from the page. Every literal in the ledger is a line that reader quoted. A figure is the number printed in its literal.
limits: No copy of a page was kept, so there is no snapshot hash. A reader who doubts a figure opens the url and finds the literal.
The Premier League rows are one journalist's tally of overturned decisions. The league publishes no split of its own that was found.

THE PUBLISHERS COUNT DIFFERENT LEAGUES AND SEASONS: the Premier League 2022-23 to 2024-25 by one outlet, Serie A 2017-18 by two (a former referee and a news agency), Ligue 1 2023-24 by the league itself, the Bundesliga 2025-26 by one outlet. No season from 2022-23 on is counted by two publishers: six readers looked on 2026-10-10 and found none. The lead's standard of Round 1303 (2026-10-11) allows that for a simulation rate, a parameter of the match engine that no screen prints as a statistic of a real league, as long as two independent publishers agree within a factor of two, and asks that this receipt says so. The standard block below is written by the generator from the rows.

Goals ruled out is derived from the lowest reading on file, the French league's own count of Ligue 1 2023-24 (23 in 306). The two counts of Serie A 2017-18, that league's first season under review and before semi automated offside, sit just above it. The highest reading (the Premier League 2022-23 by one outlet) is 1.93 times the lowest, so the game rules out about half as many goals as that English season did.
Penalties awarded is derived the same way from its lowest reading, and that kind of review is not played by the game: see owed penalties-total in the ledger.

A rate that meets the standard is not yet a kind the game plays. The ledger's kinds block is the switch for each kind, and Round 1303 measured that the goal kind alone takes about 0.074 goals a match out of the game (ten fleets, runner result r1303-gap), more than the 0.05 the balance harnesses let a rule move: see owed goals-level in the ledger. So neither kind is played and CM_VAR_LIVE is false.
Matches a season is arithmetic on the league's size, not a figure read on the page, except where the literal prints it.

standard.rule: A simulation rate stands on at least two independent publishers, each counting at least one full season of a top division under video review, whose per match figures agree within a factor of 2. It is derived from the lowest of them. No screen prints a rate as a statistic of a real league.
standard.goalsRuledOut: goals ruled out after a review, per match: 6 readings by 4 publishers, who count DIFFERENT leagues and seasons (Ligue 1 2023-24; Serie A 2017-18; Premier League 2024-25; Premier League 2023-24; Premier League 2022-23): 23 in 306 (lfp-ligue1-2023-24), 29 in 380 (pieri-seriea-2017-18), 31 in 380 (agi-seriea-2017-18), 47 in 380 (espn-pl-2024-25), 50 in 380 (espn-pl-2023-24), 55 in 380 (espn-pl-2022-23). The highest is 1.926 times the lowest, inside the factor of 2 the standard allows. Derived from the LOWEST, 23 in 306 (lfp-ligue1-2023-24).
